source: Bunya — App Service Plan rule expansion
notes: Expands appServicePlan coverage past the 5 existing rules with a mix of enforceable predicates (MIN-PLAN, INSTANCES, NAM) and advisory entries for controls Bunya's property model cannot evaluate (AUTOSCALE, RELIABILITY-ZONES, FORCED-HTTPS). The companion graph-level bundle lives at lib/rules/graph-rules/expansion-app-service-plan.ts.
